14.Transfect as follows:a.Add 0.5 μg of each plasmid-encoding effector and anchor (1:1 ratio; total 1 μg) to 100 μL Opti-MEM (Thermo Fisher Scientific) in a 5-mL polystyrene round-bottom tube.b.Add 3 μL FuGENE HD (Promega) and mix gently to avoid introducing bubbles.c.Incubate the transfection mixture at room temperature (15°C–25°C) for 10 min.d.Add 100 μL of the mixture to the cells that are plated on a 3.5-cm poly-lysine-coated glass-bottom dish and mix gently.

steps.title: Prepare LB agar plates
steps.instruction: Make LB agar containing 50 µg/mL kanamycin: dissolve 1 g tryptone (1 %), 0.5 g dried yeast extract (0.5 %), 1 g NaCl (1 %), and 1.5 g STAR Agar L‑grade (1.5 %) in Milli‑Q water, bring volume to 100 mL, add 100 µL of a 50 mg/mL kanamycin stock to reach 50 µg/mL, autoclave, pour plates, store at 4 °C protected from light and use within one month.

steps.title: Prepare LB liquid medium
steps.instruction: Make LB broth containing 50 µg/mL kanamycin: dissolve 1 g tryptone (1 %), 0.5 g dried yeast extract (0.5 %), 1 g NaCl (1 %) in Milli‑Q water, bring volume to 100 mL, add 100 µL of a 50 mg/mL kanamycin stock to reach 50 µg/mL, store at room temperature (15 °C–25 °C) without antibiotics until use; medium may be prepared a day ahead.

steps.title: Transform plasmids into competent E. coli
steps.instruction: Day 1: Thaw ECOS‑competent E. coli DH5α on ice. Add 10 ng plasmid to 20 µL competent cells in a 1.5‑mL tube, mix gently, incubate on ice 20 min, heat‑shock at 42 °C for 45 s, place on ice 3 min, add 50 µL LB (no antibiotics), incubate 37 °C 60 min, warm LB agar plates with 50 µg/mL kanamycin at 37 °C 60 min, spread the entire mixture onto the plates, incubate overnight (16–18 h) at 37 °C.

steps.title: Culture selected clone overnight
steps.instruction: Day 2: Pick a single colony, inoculate into 100 mL LB broth containing 50 µg/mL kanamycin in a 200‑mL flask, shake at 37 °C, 160 rpm for 16–18 h.

steps.title: Harvest bacteria and purify plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: Day 3: Transfer the overnight culture into two 50‑mL conical tubes, centrifuge at 4,000 × g, 4 °C for 10 min, discard supernatant (pellets may be stored at –80 °C). Purify plasmid DNA using the PureLink™ HiPure Plasmid Midiprep Kit according to the manufacturer’s protocol; use DNA with A260/A280 ≥ 1.8 at a final concentration of 1 mg/mL. Alternative kits (QIAGEN Midi or NucleoBond Xtra Midi) may be used per their instructions.

steps.title: Transfect cells with iCMM plasmids
steps.instruction: Day 1 (transfection): In a 5‑mL polystyrene round‑bottom tube combine 0.5 µg each of the effector and anchor plasmids (total 1 µg) with 100 µL Opti‑MEM, add 3 µL FuGENE HD, mix gently to avoid bubbles, incubate 10 min at room temperature (15 °C–25 °C). Add the 100 µL mixture to cells plated on a 3.5‑cm poly‑lysine‑coated glass‑bottom dish, mix gently, then culture cells at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 20–32 h. (Plasmid amounts and ratios may be optimized for each cell line; alternative transfection reagents such as Lipofectamine 3000 can be used per the supplier’s protocol.)
